name: g76_db_ally_ko
purpose: Step G76 (decision 0015 5cg), evidence for the ally rule: Gardevoir (faster) takes two Earthquakes on turn 1, uses Destiny Bond on turn 2, and is then knocked out by its own Golurk's Earthquake (Golurk is slower, so the ally's hit follows the flag). The ally's KO does not trigger Destiny Bond: no -activate line, and no foe faints.
